basic_details.job_title: Nalgonda District Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 22 Watchman, Messenger and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Nalgonda District has announced 22 vacancies for Office Subordinate, Kamati, Watchman, Vanta Manipi, Messenger, and Sanitary Jawan posts. Eligible candidates can apply through the prescribed offline application process by sending their forms via registered post or submitting them in person to the District Welfare Officer, Office of the District Welfare Officer, Women, Children on or before 29 October 2026. Qualifications vary by post, including 5th Class pass and 7th Class pass requirements as specified in the official notification under advertisement number 01/2026. The notified pay is as per

content_sections.heading: Nalgonda District Recruitment 2026 at a Glance

rows.details: Office Subordinate, Kamati, Watchman, Vanta Manipi, Messenger, Sanitary Jawan
5th Class pass, 7th Class pass, or 10th Class pass depending on the post

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in the prescribed bio-data format along with required certificates and a passport-size photograph pasted on the form. The completed application must be sent via registered post or submitted in person to the following address: District Welfare Officer, Mahila, Shishu Divyangula mariyu Vayovruddhula Samkshema Sakha, Samkshema Bhavan, Collectorate Complex, Nalgonda - 508001 Candidates must write "Divyangula Backlog Postkoraku Darakhastumuni" on the cover containing the application.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Office Subordinate: 7th Class pass. Age: 18 years to 54 years as on 01-07-2026 (relaxed up to 18 years as per G.O.Ms.No. 759, 06-10-2007, G.O.Ms.No. 86, 18-05-2026, and G.O.Ms.No. 51, 10-11-2021). Kamati: 5th Class pass. Age: 18 years to 54 years as on 01-07-2026. Watchman: 5th Class pass. Age: 18 years to 54 years as on 01-07-2026. Vanta Manipi: 5th Class pass. Age: 18 years to 54 years as on 01-07-2026. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copy of physical fitness certificate (Sadar) issued by the District Medical Board. Educational qualification certificates. Study certificates from 1st class to 7th class. Nativity or residence certificate issued by the competent authority (Tahsildar) for candidates who studied outside the district or private study candidates, along with parents' residence certificate. Caste certificate if applicable. Aadhaar card.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on verification of qualifications, required study certificates, physical fitness certificates, and merit as per rules specified in G.O.Ms.No. 124, dated 30-08-2018 and G.O.Ms.No. 104, dated 24-03-2000.

faq.question: Q1. What is Nalgonda District Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification for filling backlog vacancies of Persons with Disabilities (PwBD) across various posts in Nalgonda District.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 22 vacancies are available for various posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 29 October 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline via registered post or in person.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 years and 54 years of age as of 01-07-2026, as per government orders.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for Office Subordinate?
Q7. Is there any application fee mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent to the District Welfare Officer, Mahila, Shishu Divyangula mariyu Vayovruddhula Samkshema Sakha, Samkshema Bhavan, Collectorate Complex, Nalgonda - 508001.

faq.question: Q9. What documents need to be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Enclosures include the physical fitness certificate (Sadar), educational certificates, study certificates from 1st to 7th class, nativity/residence certificate, caste certificate, and Aadhaar card.
